title: The $800 Loophole That Shipped A Billion Boxes
source: Source: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Section 321 'de minimis' entry data, 2015-2024 (de minimis shipments grew from ~134 million in 2015 to ~1.36 billion in 2024, over 60% China-origin). 2025-2026 figures are post-policy estimates following the White House executive order ending the de minimis exemption for all countries, effective Aug 29, 2025. Figures approximate.
